propositions: A declarative metric registry must map each metric id to its lens, data source, compute function, and confidence level so the command is written once without modification as new signals accrue
Metrics with no available data must return an Unavailable state carrying a populated reason and ISO-formatted accruing_since timestamp instead of being absent from output
Every metric value must carry source and confidence labels to enable downstream aggregation to segregate high-confidence structural series from classified/backfilled values
The is_authoritative helper function must return False for backfill_classified sources and authoritative aggregation must exclude non-authoritative values from composite series
Registry entries must enforce uniqueness of metric ids and require presence of lens, source, and confidence fields for every registered metric
